comments.body: I think it would be better to explicitly set `select` here. That way you don't have to try and remember what is in the default rule set.
Could you elaborate on these and what needs fixing?

comments.body:
I still think it would be too to include in each comment what each rule is, and why we are ignoring it.
```suggestion
    # The following rules will make extensive changes, we will adopt these gradually in the future
    "UP007",  # Update Union type annotations to use the | operator
    "UP031",  # Replace printf style string formatting with f-strings
    "UP032",  # Replace .format() style string formatting with f-strings
    "UP033",  # Use functools.cache instead of functools.lru_cache
```
